```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library("dplyr") # data cleaning and handling

# Load project configuration
source(here::here("R", "load_config.R"))
cfg <- load_config()
 
## file path for means and distributions

input_means <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$outout_file_ACS_1year_means
)

input_dis <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$output_file_ACS_1year_IncDis
)

years <- c("2019", "2024")

# File lists from config
logit_files <- list(
  `2019` = cfg$Predict$output_file_logit_2019_1year,
  `2024` = cfg$Predict$output_file_logit_2024_1year
)

mlogit_files <- list(
  `2019` = cfg$Predict$output_file_Mult_2019_1year,
  `2024` = cfg$Predict$output_file_Mult_2024_1year
)

bespoke_files <- list(
  `2019` = cfg$Predict$output_file_bespoke_2019_1year,
  `2024` = cfg$Predict$output_file_bespoke_2024_1year
)

ppo_files <- list(
  `2019` = cfg$Predict$output_file_ppo_2019_1year,
  `2024` = cfg$Predict$output_file_ppo_2024_1year
)

# Construct input file paths
for (yr in years) {

  assign(
    paste0("predict_logit_", yr),
    file.path(
      cfg$paths$output_dir,
      logit_files[[yr]]
    )
  )

  assign(
    paste0("predict_mlogit_", yr),
    file.path(
      cfg$paths$output_dir,
      mlogit_files[[yr]]
    )
  )

  assign(
    paste0("predict_bespoke_", yr),
    file.path(
      cfg$paths$output_dir,
      bespoke_files[[yr]]
    )
  )

  assign(
    paste0("predict_ppo_", yr),
    file.path(
      cfg$paths$output_dir,
      ppo_files[[yr]]
    )
  )
}

 

```



## Load the predictions and means data


```{r}
years <- c("2019", "2024")

for (yr in years) {

    )
  )
  
  assign(
    paste0("predict_bespoke_", yr),

    )
  )  

  assign(
    paste0("predict_ppo_", yr),
    read.csv(
      get(paste0("predict_ppo_", yr))
    )
  )    
}

 

#restoring ordered factor nature to the ordered factor varriable


ACS_1year_means <-read.csv(file.path(input_means))

ACS_1year_dis <-read.csv(file.path(input_dis))


```


## Calculate the number of HH in each category 
```{r}


years <- c("2019", "2024")

for (yr in years) {

  assign(
    paste0("predict_logit_HH", yr),
    get(paste0("predict_logit_", yr)) %>%
      mutate(
        across(
          -YEAR,
          ~ .x * ACS_1year_means$NHH
        )
      )
  )
  
  assign(
    paste0("predict_mlogit_HH", yr),
    get(paste0("predict_mlogit_", yr)) %>%
      mutate(
        across(
          -YEAR,
          ~ .x * ACS_1year_means$NHH
        )
      )
  )

  assign(
    paste0("predict_bespoke_HH", yr),
    get(paste0("predict_bespoke_", yr)) %>%
      mutate(
        across(
          -YEAR,
          ~ .x * ACS_1year_means$NHH
        )
      )
  ) 
  
  assign(
    paste0("predict_ppo_HH", yr),
    get(paste0("predict_ppo_", yr)) %>%
      mutate(
        across(
          -YEAR,
          ~ .x * ACS_1year_means$NHH
        )
      )
  )  
}


```

## Run chi squared tests on the distributions 

```{r}


results_logit <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ACS_1year_dis)), function(i) {

  obs <- unlist(ACS_1year_dis[i, -1])
  pred <- unlist(predict_logit_HH2019[i, -1])

  test <- chisq.test(
    x = obs,
    p = pred / sum(pred)
  )

  data.frame(
    Year = ACS_1year_dis$YEAR[i],
    ChiSq = unname(test$statistic),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})


results_ppo <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ACS_1year_dis)), function(i) {

  obs <- unlist(ACS_1year_dis[i, -1])
  pred <- unlist(predict_ppo_HH2019[i, -1])

  test <- chisq.test(
    x = obs,
    p = pred / sum(pred)
  )

  data.frame(
    Year = ACS_1year_dis$YEAR[i],
    ChiSq = unname(test$statistic),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

print(results_ppo)

```
